name: Synthetic source-contract mutation sensitivity
selection: First 100 rows by original source order in each captured remaining-split SELECTED file for mmlu and mmlu-pro. 200 source units already examined in the prior extension. No outcome-based filtering.
render: Controlled synthetic renderer uses complete official question and labelled source options. It is deliberately not a new native-framework execution. Mutation probes are remeasured by substituting a nonce question through the same renderer.

conditions.identity: Official full question and original options
conditions.trim_only: Strip only option edge whitespace; gold remains index-aligned
conditions.coherent_permutation: Rotate complete option sequence by one and align gold index
conditions.distractor_replace: Replace first option differing from gold with a unique nonce; retain gold
conditions.distractor_drop: Drop first option differing from gold and update label for retained gold
conditions.duplicate_gold: Replace first option differing from gold with gold text
conditions.question_truncation: Render first floor(n/2) question characters, minimum1, preserving positive mutation dependence
conditions.question_omission: Omit question entirely; remeasured probe must be false
conditions.gold_removed: Replace the actual gold option by a unique nonce, retain official correct text
conditions.wrong_reference: Set native reference to first non-gold option label
conditions.missing_source: Remove source question/options/index evidence while retaining a complete v1 record

v2_design: A separate wrapper requires source question/options/gold index, full source-question substring in visible prompt, exact normalized option multiset (allow coherent permutations), source-gold agreement and all v1 checks. Original v1 bytes unchanged. This is a bounded string/content contract, not semantic correctness or cryptographic provenance.
truth: identity/trim/permutation benign controls; replace/drop/duplicate/truncate/omission/gold_removed/wrong_reference altered-task controls; missing_source incomplete evidence. Synthetic diagnostics, no prevalence estimate or significance test.
exceptions: Keep every selected source unit and all mutation dispositions. If no differing distractor exists, mark non-applicable without replacing row.
interpretation: V2 is developed from structural inspection and assessed on synthetic design cases, not independent held-out validation. Freeze code and protocol before execution.
